subject: New Shiny Server does not allow our proxy connections anymore

messages.author: c1629c4c1cffcc0e
messages.subject: New Shiny Server does not allow our proxy connections anymore
parts:
Hello everyone,

Since we updated our Shiny Server (Pro) to the latest version recently, our sessions are no longer able to connect.

[Log] Sat Oct 15 2016 17:31:55 GMT-0700 (PDT) [INF]: Error: WebSocket closed (shiny-server-client.min.js, line 1)
[Log] Sat Oct 15 2016 17:31:55 GMT-0700 (PDT) [INF]: Connection closed. Info: {"isTrusted":false} (shiny-server-client.min.js, line 1)
[Log] Sat Oct 15 2016 17:31:55 GMT-0700 (PDT) [DBG]: SockJS connection closed (shiny-server-client.min.js, line 1)
[Log] Sat Oct 15 2016 17:31:55 GMT-0700 (PDT) [DBG]: Channel 0 is closed (shiny-server-client.min.js, line 1)
[Log] Sat Oct 15 2016 17:31:55 GMT-0700 (PDT) [DBG]: Removed channel 0, 0 left (shiny-server-client.min.js, line 1)

I imagine this has something to do with the way we proxy the connection to our Shiny Server using PHP.  Is there any way to fix it?

What does the second line from the logs mean, where it says "isTrusted:false"?  Is there a way to manually force it to be trusted?  Or maybe I'm misunderstanding that part?

Any help would be greatly appreciated.  We are a bit stuck right now.

Much thanks to all!
~Laz Peterson

My amateur guess is that it has something to do with the new keep alive type networking that you guys put in.  Since it is going through a PHP-based proxy (for auth/security purposes), it seems that this might be confusing SSP?

Thanks for your help Joe.  I do appreciate it!
